name: Farliazuzco
backstory: Child of Forliauzco and Farliazco; grew up around unloads crates at the market stalls through the... in Terfila, and knows something of Birth Of Dorukus.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Tamuzco and Farliukar now have a child, Tamuzarlo.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Farlo and Trezco now have a child, Trezarlo.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Forliuken, named Forliukar.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Forliazco has died.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Forliamuk and Tamuzco now have a child, Tamuzmuken.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Farliazco, named Farliauzco.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Tamuzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliuzco.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Trezco and Tamuken now have a child, Tamuzco.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Trezarlo has died.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Farlo has died.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliukar now have a child, Forliaukarli.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Salthos Mediator Line their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Salthos Mediator Line as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: hauls crates at the market stalls through the morning tide same as his father did, trading gossip for a cheaper drink, and adding his own flourish to the tollhouse story each time he tells it.

arc.premise: Farliazuzco wants to press one of the old Salthos line's own descendants for a straight answer on whether the mediator role was actually offered or just taken - the family story at the stalls assumes one answer, and he wants to hear it from someone who'd know.
